source:
@type tail path /var/log/*.log pos_file /tmp/trace.log.pos tag kubernetes.* skip_refresh_on_startup true read_from_head true
@type multiline format_firstline /^\\[\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2} \\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{3}\\]\\s+\\[[^\\]]+\\]\\s+.*$/ format1 /(?.*)/
filter:
@type parser key_name message reserve_data true
@type regexp expression /^\\[(?\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2} \\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{3})\\]\\s+\\[(?[^\\]]+)\\]\\s+(?.*)/ keep_time_key true time_key log_timestamp time_format %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S:%L timezone +08
match:
@type elasticsearch @log_level trace host elasticsearch-fz1.engmon.svc.cluster.local port 9200 scheme http ssl_verify true ssl_version TLSV1_2 user use_default password use_default suppress_type_name true default_elasticsearch_version 7 logstash_prefix \"#{ENV['POD_NAMESPACE']}\" logstash_dateformat '%Y.%m.%d' logstash_format true max_retry_get_es_version 5 max_retry_putting_template 5 reload_connection false reconnect_on_error true reload_on_failure true log_es_400_reason true
flush_interval 5s chunk_limit_size 8M retry_forever true overflow_action block timekey 10s timekey_wait 5s
